title: International territorial level 3, January 2021 (United Kingdom, generalised, clipped)
description: The finest tier of the ITL geography, the level regional gross domestic product and productivity are published at.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "International_Territorial_Level_3_January_2021_UK_BGC_V3_2022" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/International_Territorial_Level_3_January_2021_UK_BGC_V3_2022/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 179 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
